definitions.gloss: one level; one step; one tier
definitions.explanation: A single step or level in a staircase, hierarchy, or gradation.
Used adverbially to mean 'even more' or 'to a greater degree.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一段|いちだん}⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: I go up one step on the stairs.

examples.japanese: {一段|いちだん}⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I aim for the next level up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一段|いちだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained first dan in judo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧{一段|いちだん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It became even colder as autumn arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}して→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧{一段|いちだん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧になった。
examples.english: I practiced and became even better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一段|いちだん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The new product's performance improved even more.

notes:
{一段|いちだん} has multiple uses.

COMMON PATTERNS:
In Japanese grammar, {一段|いちだん}⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧ (ichidan verbs) are verbs whose stems end in the same sound before conjugation (e.g., ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧, ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧).

MARTIAL ARTS:
⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ is a rank in martial arts like ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧, ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧, ⟦{空手|からて}→空手：04454_karate⟧. {一段|いちだん} (first dan) is typically the first black belt level.

ADVERBIAL USE:
{一段|いちだん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ means "even more" or "to a greater degree," emphasizing an increase or improvement.
